sections.title: Resonance Skill: Dream Blend

lines: Casting this skill sends Lily into Slumberland and grants Cradle Lullaby to Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill also grants Lily a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. This Shield does not carry over to the incoming Resonator.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Slumber

Lasts for 50s. When Lily is in Slumberland, she heals the nearby active Resonator every 3s. During Slumberland, use directional input to command Dreambind to deal Spectro DMG to nearby targets. Dreambind pulls in targets within a certain range every 5s, and stops attacking 10s after movement stops. Press Resonance Liberation again during Slumberland to end it early.

When Lily is in Slumberland, when a Resonator in the team casts Intro Skill, targets within a certain range are pulled in, triggered once every 10s. Lily is immune to interruption during Slumberland and takes 50% less DMG.
Switching to another Resonator during Slumberland keeps Lily on the field. Lily leaves the field when Slumberland ends, or earlier if she gets too far from the active Resonator.
Cradle Lullaby
Lasts for 25s. While this effect is active, each Intro Skill cast by a Resonator in the team grants 1 stack of Dream Aroma. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator.
Dream Aroma

Stacks up to 4 times. Each stack increases the ATK of all Resonators on the team by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen above 190%, up to 7%. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator or when Cradle Lullaby ends.

lines: Dream Perfume
Lily can hold up to 300 points.
Basic Attack, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter restore Dream Perfume on hit.
After casting Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend or Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend, restore 130 points of Dream Perfume.
Casting Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom restores 130 points of Dream Perfume.
Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale

When Dream Perfume is full, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale, consuming all Dream Perfume to grant 1 stack of Dream Shelter. During the skill, she pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals Spectro DMG to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale grants Lily Wish of Praying Dream.
Switching to another Resonator during Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale stops the skills immediately.
Lily continuously gains Dreambell Chime during the skill.

When Dreambell Chime reaches 300 points, press or hold Normal Attack to stop the skill immediately and cast Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale. Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale is automatically cast at the end of Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale. Casting Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale consumes all Dreambell Chime.
Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale
Attack targets within range, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains an additional 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and an additional 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Casting the skill grants Lily Sillage for 6s. Casting Outro Skill consumes Sillage and grants Silvered Dream to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm

When Dream Perfume is full, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm, consuming all Dream Perfume to grant 1 stack of Dream Shelter. During the skill, she pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals Spectro DMG to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm grants Lily Wish of Praying Dream.
Switching to another Resonator during Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm stops the skill immediately.
Lily continuously gains Dreambell Chime during the skill.

When Dreambell Chime reaches 300 points, press or hold Normal Attack to stop the skill immediately and cast Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End. Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End is automatically cast at the end of Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm. Casting Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End consumes all Dreambell Chime.
Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End
Attack targets within range, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains an additional 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and an additional 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Casting this skill grants Lily Sillage for 6s. Casting Outro Skill consumes Sillage and grants Silvered Dream to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Silvered Dream
Lasts for 30s.

When the Resonator with this effect is the Active Resonator and can trigger Unison Response, each stack of Unison Boon on the team increases their ATK by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen above 190%, up to 7%, counting up to 4 stacks of Unison Boon.

The active Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. Rate and Echo Skill Crit. DMG are increased. Every 0.7% of Lily's Energy Regen above 190% increases Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 0.1%, up to 10%. Every 0.7% of Lily's Energy Regen above 190% increases Echo Skill Crit. DMG by 0.2%, up to 20%.
All Resonators in the team gain resistance to interruption.
Dream Shelter

Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm grants 1 stack of Dream Shelter, stacking up to 1 time. Receiving damage from an enemy target consumes 1 stack of Dream Shelter to grant Lily immunity to interruption and reduce the DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.
Wish of Praying Dream
Can be gained once every 25s.
When Lily has Wish of Praying Dream, this Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm consumes Wish of Praying Dream to increase the skill's healing by 400%.

lines: Sunbringer's skills deal Sharp DMG, with DEF used as the skill DMG Multiplier. Some Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash is full, the enemy enters [Gash]. [Gash] can stack up to 3 times. When certain heavy attacks from Sunbringer's skills hit an enemy in the [Gash] state, 1 stack of [Gash] is consumed to deal AoE DMG once;

When Sharp DMG triggers a critical hit, it does not benefit from CRIT DMG Bonus and uses Laceration DMG Bonus instead. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has been triggered, an additional Laceration check is made based on the excess CRIT Rate. Triggering Laceration applies Laceration DMG Bonus one additional time. For every 1% initial CRIT DMG Sunbringer has, Sunbringer's initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%;
Sunbringer recovers 60 Sharpness upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s;

When Sunbringer enters combat, Sunbringer gains [Midnight Sun], increasing CRIT Rate by 40% and ignoring 20% of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. [Midnight Sun] lasts 20s. While Sunbringer is off field or Dracaene is on field, its duration does not decrease. Sunbringer regains [Midnight Sun] when activating any [EX Special Attack] or [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];
Daze dealt by Dracaene's [Defensive Assist] is increased by 50%. Gash Buildup Rate of Eldreda's and Lindverne's [Assist Follow-Up] is increased by 15%, and DMG dealt is increased by 20%;

When any Agent in the squad triggers [Maim], Sunbringer gains 40 [Wishfire] for each stack of [Gash] removed, up to a maximum of 160 [Wishfire]. With at least 120 [Wishfire], Sunbringer can consume 120 [Wishfire] to activate [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];

When a teammate triggers [Maim], if Sunbringer has enough [Wishfire], [Quick Assist] is triggered. When Sunbringer switches on field via [Quick Assist], 120 [Wishfire] is consumed to directly activate [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge]. This effect can trigger once every 3s;

When Sunbringer's [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge], [EX Special Attack: Night Blaze - End of the Long Dark], [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day], [Ultimate: "Onward, Together"], or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy and deals DMG, the target accumulates [Ember Scar], with the amount of [Ember Scar] equal to 65% of the actual DMG dealt by the skill. When the Finishing Move of Eldreda's [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day] or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy, all [Ember Scar] is removed, triggering 1 [Ashfall] effect and directly deducting an equal amount of HP.
When an enemy is defeated, Sunbringer recovers 40 [Wishfire]. This effect can trigger once every 60s.

sections.title: Ultimate

lines: When Robin uses certain skills, she grants all squad members a [Guardian Shield] of varying strength based on her initial Max HP, lasting 15s. When a character gains [Guardian Shield] again, the shield amount stacks and its duration is extended, up to a maximum of 60s. The shield amount cannot exceed 12% of Robin's initial Max HP;
Each time a squad member gains [Guardian Shield], their DMG dealt increases by 25% for 20s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration;

Using [Special Attack: Off-Field] triggers a Quick Assist. After being switched out, Robin enters the [Off-Field Guard] state for 80s. While in [Off-Field Guard], Robin gains [Entry Points] when she unleashes Aftershocks, up to a maximum of 140 points;

When Robin has 120 or more [Entry Points], she can be actively switched in via her [Entry Skill]. Upon switching in, 120 [Entry Points] are automatically consumed to unleash her [Entry Skill], and Robin exits the [Off-Field Guard] state;
When using her [Entry Skill], Robin gains 1 [Buff Enhance Point], up to a maximum of 1;
Upon entering the [Off-Field Guard] state, if Robin has a [Buff Enhance Point], 1 [Buff Enhance Point] is consumed to further increase the DEF boost provided by [Off-Field Guard] and its cap by 25%;

If a Quick Assist is triggered after using an Entry Skill, Ultimate, Chain Attack, or Assist Follow-Up, and characters are switched within 1.5s, Robin automatically stays on the field to unleash [Special Attack: Off-Field], during which she is invulnerable;
Robin gains 1 [Buff Enhance Point] when performing a [Counter Assist] or [Chain Parry];
After a [Chain Parry], if Robin is not the active character, she automatically unleashes [Special Attack: Off-Field], during which she is invulnerable;
Each time any squad member triggers Maim, Robin recovers 15 Energy.
